recommended_cutover_phases.title: Gateway demotion to ingress and protocol adapter
recommended_cutover_phases.description: Leave gateway route wiring and HTTP concerns in place; move execution decisions behind a kernel execute() interface.
actions: Introduce a gateway-to-kernel adapter that wraps ExecutionRuntime.initialize/execute.
Replace direct gateway pipeline creation and event persistence with kernel boundary invocation.
Keep gateway routes /events, /api/v1/repository, /context, /system, /api/v1/ollama, /health as ingress only.

recommended_cutover_phases.title: Kernel boundary promotion for event write and execution lifecycle
recommended_cutover_phases.description: Redirect event creation and mission execution flows from gateway runtime to kernel runtime.
actions: Refactor gateway/routes/events.js POST /events to call kernel.execute() instead of gateway-local pipeline.execute.
Move EventRepository persistence, event schema creation, verification, reducer dispatch, projection, and replay decision logic into kernel runtime modules.
Retain EventReadAuthority in gateway for query-only paths, but ensure it reads the canonical repository created by kernel runtime.

recommended_cutover_phases.title: Kernel mediation proof and route ownership consolidation
recommended_cutover_phases.description: Ensure static route graph evidence shows gateway routes delegating to kernel runtime instead of owning execution semantics.
actions: Use static invocation boundaries: gateway route -> kernel execute adapter -> runtime/ExecutionRuntime -> authorities/adapters.
Remove or retire legacy_commit_service routes unless they are explicitly reclassed as kernel service adapters.
Mark all gateway route handlers as gateway-only, with any event mutation or infrastructure call delegated to kernel authorities.

recommended_cutover_phases.title: Runtime cleanup and adapter boundary enforcement
recommended_cutover_phases.description: Finalize the cutover by enforcing the kernel authority boundary and cleaning residual gateway execution logic.
actions: Audit gateway modules for execution logic and move remaining runtime control responsibilities into kernel modules.
Keep gateway adapters only for transport and persistence, not execution policy.
Ensure event emission, witness certification, and replay decisions are solely kernel-owned.

route_cutover_summary.recommended_mediation: kernel boundary should own execution and event write; gateway should only delegate to kernel execute
route_cutover_summary.notes: Route is currently implemented inside gateway HTTP stack and has no static kernel mediation proof.
